texts.Name: Anton Dziatkovskii
texts.Tell us about a piece of exceptional wor: A production multi-machine Claude fleet (6 machines) that I run in public: cross-machine consensus (claw-consensus - reproducible multi-machine agent consensus with an offline demo and published evals), persistent memory over a 10-year knowledge base, a CRM layer, and 100+ automation routines. The part I am most proud of is the reliability work: published agent-fleet evals (07.2026) where 0/17 high-risk Tier-2 actions slipped past the human approval gate in recorded runs, failure modes documented publicly (FAILURE-MODES.md), plus verbatim-citation-gate - a zero-token gate and burden-of-proof judge that catches fabricated RAG citations (MIT).
texts.Why do you want to work at Mem0?: Memory is the part of the agent stack I already live in: my fleet runs persistent memory over a 10-year knowledge base (RAG + SQLite; public repos include sqlite-graph-memory and second-brain-starter-kit), and my day-to-day is deploying that into messy real-world workflows. Mem0 is building exactly that layer as a product, and Forward Deployed is how I actually work: I ship working agent systems end-to-end (MCP connectors, RAG, evals) and can sit in front of a customer - 15+ years founder/BD background, including compliance-heavy environments (banks, governments in SE Asia).
